messages.text:
Hi everyone! 👋

Good afternoon! I was wondering if you could let me know when you’ll have bundles available again on your website.

I’m really interested in getting one, so I’d appreciate any information you can share. 😊

Thanks in advance! 🙌

Good afternoon. Most of our bundles are sold out right now, and I don't have a restock date for them yet. I won't guess one.

Two are still live. The NerdOctaxe + free NerdQX bundle is $499, but only with the UK plug. There's also a 3-pack of Bitaxe v2 units for $99, which isn't offered in the US.

Which bundle were you after, and which country would it ship to? I'll check whether there's anything that works for you now, or find out when it's coming back.

I wanted a '1 NerdQaxe++ Rev6.1, get 1 Bitaxe Supra Hex 703 free' bundle shipped to Portugal 🇵🇹. But I think it's not available in Europe. The 3-Bitaxe pack isn't available in Europe either. When it is, I'll buy.

You're right, that bundle is sold out for Portugal. The Bitaxe Supra is no longer available, so I can't promise the bundle will come back as it was.

The closest thing I can sell you today is the Hammer Miner BC04, $239. It has the same 6 TH/s as the NerdQaxe++ but uses about 100W instead of 150W. It also has Ethernet, and it's in stock with an EU plug.

Would the BC04 work for you? If you'd rather wait for a bundle, send me your email and I'll ask the team to write to you when one comes back for Europe.
Ok, my email is (email hidden) When you have bundles available, let me know — I'll buy a bundle with you. Best regards to the whole team.
Handed to the team · No EU restock date in the catalog for bundles; customer asked to be notified whe

I've passed it to the team. They'll email you at (email hidden) as soon as a bundle is available to order for Portugal. If you stay in the chat, one of them may reply here too.

Thanks for waiting for the right deal, and best regards from all of us here too.
